segments.comment: options.c add_menu_cmd_alias() (8076-8092): the 33rd BIND of a menu command and the menu_previous_page option overflow MAX_MENU_MAPPED_CMDS (32), so each prints "out of menu map space." through pline.c's early raw_print(); the unknown option that follows makes config_error_done() wait, which keeps that raw output on the screen.
